title: REMOVAL OF QUARTER WINDOW GLASS
ocr_text:
REMOVAL OF QUARTER WINDOW GLASS

1. REMOVE SEAT BELT SHOULDER BELT ANCHOR
(a) Remove the anchor cover.
(b) Remove the anchor bolt.

2. REMOVE BELT GUIDE
(a) Remove the screw.
(b) Pry loose one clip with a screwdriver and remove the belt guide.

3. REMOVE CENTER PILLAR INNER GARNISH
Pry loose two clips with a screwdriver and remove the garnish.

4. REMOVE LOWER BACK PANEL COVER

5. REMOVE REAR SPEAKER GRILLE
(a) Remove the screws.
(b) Pry loose two clips with a screwdriver and remove the grille.

6. REMOVE DECK SIDE TRIM AND SIDE GARNISH
(a) Remove the deck side trim.
(b) Pry loose three clips with a screwdriver and remove the side garnish.

7. REMOVE REAR SPEAKER AND BRACKET

8. REMOVE QUARTER TRIM
(a) Pry loose three clips with a screwdriver.
(b) Pull loose two retainers and remove the quarter trim.
